cache_limit.text: Playback needs {needed} GB more, but only {available} GB of the {limit} GB cache is left. Raise the cache limit in the panel: Settings → Storage.

settings.linkHint: Open it in VLC or Infuse. The link works for 12 h

errors.unreachable: Couldn't reach {address}. Check the address and that the server is running

auth.name: Name

auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {n} min

wizard.label: First run
wizard.note: Everything you set here can be changed later in the panel.

account.title: Create the owner account
account.text: You use it to sign in to the panel and set up the server. There is one account per server: the household watches through profiles on the TV.
account.emailHint: Only for signing in. The server sends no email.

checks.title: Checks
checks.retryFix: The server did not respond. Make sure the Torsher container is running and select Check again.

storage.title: Storage
storage.text: Where the server keeps its database and downloads, and how much space the viewing cache may take. Watching downloads into the cache; old items are removed when it is full.

data.created: Data folder will be created on start

downloads.created: Downloads folder will be created on the first download

storage.fixWrite: The owner of the files on the host must match the container's PUID and PGID (on the host: id -u and id -g). Fix them in docker-compose.yml or grant access to the volume folder, then restart the container.

space.low: {free} free: the cache limit will not fit
space.lowFix: Lower the cache limit below or free up space on the volume. Otherwise the server starts removing old cache items before the limit.
space.criticalFix: Free up space or lower the reserve below. While free space is below the reserve, playback does not start and downloads pause.

library.created: Library folder will be created on start

links.hardlink: Kept files go to the library without extra space
links.hardlinkText: Downloads and the library share one volume: a file is hard-linked and keeps seeding.
links.reflinkText: Files are copied without extra space: the filesystem shares the same blocks.
links.copy: Downloads and the library are on different volumes: files will be copied
links.copyText: A kept file takes space twice until the torrent is evicted from the cache.
links.copyFix: Choose downloads and library folders on one volume in the Folders card below, for example /data/torrents and /data/library. Two volumes, even on one disk, don’t allow hard links.

network.title: Network
network.text: The showcase catalog and images come from TMDB. Let's check that the server reaches it and turn on DoH or your own key if needed.

fix.dns: Choose DoH in the Default DNS card below, save it and select Check again.
fix.doh: Choose another DoH provider in the Default DNS card below.
fix.blocked: Check the server's internet connection. If the address is unreachable from your network, add a proxy route for it in Settings → Network after the wizard.

key.rejectedFix: Paste your own key in the card below: TMDB issues it in your account settings, API section.
key.unavailable: Key not checked: TMDB is unreachable
key.unavailableFix: Fix access to TMDB above first, then select Check again.
key.missingFix: This build has no app key. Paste your own key in the card below — TMDB issues it in your account settings, API section.

sources.title: Sources
sources.text: The server looks for torrents in Torznab indexers. Connecting an indexer manager is the fastest way: the server has already looked for one nearby.
sources.discovering: Looking for Prowlarr and Jackett on the local network…
sources.notFoundText: Checked the prowlarr and jackett services, the Docker host, the container network gateway and this machine on ports 9696 and 9117.
sources.notFoundFix: If the manager runs on another address or port, connect it by address below. If you have no manager, start Prowlarr from the install example and select Check again.
sources.noIndexersText: The showcase finds movies and series, but there is nothing to watch them from.

connect.title: Connect the manager found
connect.text: Torsher adds all its indexers and keeps them in sync. Only the API key is needed.
connect.hint: The server found the address, no need to enter it.

none.importText: Prowlarr or Jackett already runs at another address: enter the address and the API key.
none.composeText: The install example has Prowlarr under its own profile. Start it in the folder with docker-compose.yml, add indexers in it and check again.

done.title: The server is ready
done.text: Anything you skipped can be set up later in the panel. All that's left is to open the showcase on your TV.
done.noSources: No sources: nothing to watch yet
done.deviceText: Open this address in a browser on the TV or computer, or in the Torsher app. A six-character code appears on the screen — enter it here.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Whether the server is fine, and where to fix it if not.
overview.loadErrorText: The server didn't respond. If the panel has been open for a while, reload the page.

account.description: The server owner account. A second one can't be created: the household watches through profiles.

storage.description: Where downloads live and how much space the watch cache may take.
storage.loadErrorText: The server didn't respond. Try again.
storage.cacheText: What you watch without “Keep” stays in the cache. When it's full, the oldest is deleted automatically.
storage.reserveText: If less is left on disk, new playback won't start and the showcase explains why. Downloads pause.
storage.defaults: Defaults based on the disk size are in effect.
storage.savedText: If space is short, extra cache is deleted right away

queue.title: Deleted automatically
queue.text: When the cache is full or space runs out, these torrents go first — they haven't been opened for the longest time.
queue.empty: The cache is empty: what you watched is kept or not downloaded yet.

library.title: Library
library.hardlink: Hard link — the torrent keeps seeding without extra space
library.reflink: Reflink — a copy without extra space
library.copy: Copy — the file takes space twice until the torrent is evicted from the cache

folders.title: Folders
folders.text: Where downloads and your own library live. The container sees only mounted folders: mount a new disk in docker-compose.yml first.
folders.cancelled: Move stopped: what was moved works from the new folder

failed.no_space: The new volume ran out of space. Free up space and retry: what was moved already works from the new folder.
failed.denied: Can’t write to the new folder. Check the container’s PUID and PGID and the folder permissions.
failed.engine: The torrent engine couldn’t move a torrent. See the Log for details.
failed.exists: The new folder already has a file with the same name. Remove or rename it and retry: what was moved already works from the new folder.
failed.failed: Read or write error. See the Log for details.

folders.copyTitle: Downloads and library are on different volumes
folders.copyText: “Keep” will copy files: they take space twice until the torrent is evicted from the cache. Choose folders on one volume, for example /data/torrents and /data/library.

pathDialog.textDownloads: The torrent engine downloads torrents and the watch cache here.
pathDialog.textLibrary: “Keep” and “Download” put files here in the Jellyfin layout.
pathDialog.pathHint: Paths inside the container. Disk not listed? Mount it in docker-compose.yml and restart the container.
pathDialog.current: This is the current folder, writable
pathDialog.created: The folder doesn’t exist yet — it will be created

links.hardlink: Hard links work: “Keep” takes no extra space
links.reflink: No hard links, reflink works: copies take no extra space

problems.not_directory: This is a file, not a folder
problems.denied: Can’t write to this folder: check the container’s PUID and PGID
problems.inside_data: This is the server data folder — choose another one
problems.overlaps_other: This folder overlaps the downloads or library folder — choose a separate one
problems.library_folder: This is a connected library folder, it is read-only

pathDialog.mode: What to do with existing data
pathDialog.newOnlyDownloads: New torrents go to the new folder. What’s already downloaded stays in place and keeps seeding.
pathDialog.newOnlyLibrary: New files go to the new folder. Existing files stay in place and remain on the showcase.
pathDialog.moveDownloads: In the background, one torrent at a time: each pauses only while it moves. Old files are deleted after a check.
pathDialog.moveLibrary: In the background, one file at a time with its subtitles. Old files are deleted after a check.
pathDialog.moveSameVolume: Same volume: files move as hard links, without extra space.
pathDialog.separates: Library files will no longer be shared with torrents: kept torrents return to the cache and are deleted when it fills up.
pathDialog.moveStartedText: Progress is in the Folders card

errors.busy: A move is running. Wait for it or stop it.
errors.no_space: The new volume doesn’t have enough space for the move.
errors.unknown: The server didn’t respond. Try again.

network.description: How the server reaches TMDB, indexers and managers: directly or through your SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy, with the system DNS or DNS over HTTPS.
network.loadErrorText: The server didn't respond. Try again.

hosts.title: Availability
hosts.text: Hosts the server talks to. They are checked from the server, not from your browser.
hosts.createRoute: Create a route for this host

reasons.dns: The name doesn't resolve — try DoH
reasons.doh: The DoH provider doesn't respond — pick another one
reasons.timeout: No answer in 8 s — check the network or the proxy
reasons.refused: Connection failed — check the address or the proxy
reasons.tls: Wrong certificate — the address may be spoofed, try DoH
reasons.spoofed: System DNS is spoofed — turn on DoH for this host
reasons.spoofedRouted: System DNS is spoofed — works through the route

check.title: Checked {done} of {total}
check.hint: on the server, you can leave the page
check.doneProblems: {n} host has a problem | {n} hosts have problems

viaText.direct: The server connects to the host itself; names are resolved by the chosen DNS.
viaText.socks5h: Through your SOCKS5 proxy. Host names are resolved by the proxy.
viaText.http: Through your HTTP proxy (CONNECT). Host names are resolved by the proxy.

dnsCard.title: Default DNS
dnsCard.text: For hosts without their own route. If the provider's DNS returns wrong addresses, pick DNS over HTTPS.
dnsCard.systemHint: Names are resolved by the server's operating system.
dnsCard.proxyNote: Hosts without their own route go through a proxy: it resolves the names.
dnsCard.envProxyNote: Requests now go through the proxy from the environment (HTTPS_PROXY): it resolves the names. Choosing DoH turns it off for hosts without their own route.

routes.title: Routes
routes.text: Which hosts go through a proxy or a different DNS. A route matches the host exactly or by a mask, not part of the address.
routes.hint: An exact host beats a mask, masks apply in order.

routeDialog.description: Bring your own proxy: Torsher doesn't provide one.
routeDialog.matchHint: indexer.example — this host only, *.indexer.example — all its subdomains.
routeDialog.matchDefault: Hosts without their own route. This route can't be deleted.
routeDialog.credentialsHint: If the proxy asks for sign-in.
routeDialog.credentialsSaved: Username and password are saved. Leave empty to keep them.
routeDialog.credentialsForget: The saved username and password will be removed.
routeDialog.dnsProxy: Through a proxy, host names are resolved by the proxy: this route has no DNS setting.
routeDialog.dohUrlHint: An RFC 8484 address over https, for example https://doh.example/dns-query.

validation.match: Enter a host or a mask like *.indexer.example, without scheme, port and path

proxy.scheme: This scheme doesn't match the chosen connection

invalid.match: The server didn't accept the host or mask
invalid.proxy: The server didn't accept the proxy address
invalid.dohUrl: The server didn't accept the DoH address

duplicate.match: A route for this host already exists — edit it instead

default_route.match: The default route can't be renamed or deleted

deleteDialog.title: Delete the route for {match}?
deleteDialog.text: Its hosts will follow the other routes or the default route.

metadata.description: Where the catalog takes titles, posters and descriptions from.
metadata.tmdbText: The showcase catalog comes from TMDB. TMDB may revoke the app key at any time — your own key keeps working.
metadata.appMissing: This build has no app key
metadata.customText: An API key or a read access token from your TMDB account
metadata.keyHint: An API key (32 characters) or an API read access token.
metadata.keySaved: A key is saved. Enter a new one to replace it.
metadata.where: The key is in your TMDB account settings, API section.
metadata.noneText: Without a key the showcase catalog won't load. Enter your own key.
metadata.savedApp: The app key is in use
metadata.savedEnv: The environment key is in use
metadata.savedText: The catalog uses it from the next request

check.unavailable: TMDB is unreachable — check the network settings
check.missing: There is no key to check

validation.key: Enter the key: at least 16 characters

imdb.title: IMDb ratings
imdb.text: Once a day the server downloads the official IMDb ratings dataset and keeps it locally. The showcase shows the IMDb rating next to TMDB, with no keys or limits.
imdb.terms: The IMDb dataset is for personal and non-commercial use. By turning it on you accept the IMDb terms.
imdb.empty: The dataset hasn't been downloaded yet

error.unavailable: Download failed: IMDb is unreachable — check the network settings
error.invalid: Download failed: the dataset file is damaged

playback.description: How the server transcodes video the player can't play: old AVI files, HEVC and 10-bit video in a browser, HDR, image subtitles.

accel.title: Hardware acceleration
accel.text: A GPU transcodes video many times faster than the CPU and barely loads it. The server checks it with a test encode on startup.

playback.decodes: Decodes {codecs} itself. For other codecs the CPU decodes and the GPU encodes.
playback.decodesNothing: The CPU decodes, the GPU encodes.
playback.offText: The CPU transcodes video: the GPU is turned off with the switch below.
playback.noGpu: The server can't see a GPU
playback.noGpuHint: The CPU transcodes video. If the computer has an Intel, AMD or NVIDIA GPU, pass it through to the container.

failed.title: A GPU was found but doesn't work
failed.text: The server sees the device, but the test encode on it failed, so the CPU transcodes video. Usually the container can't access the device, the host lacks the GPU firmware, or the kernel is too old.

unavailable.title: Nothing to transcode with
unavailable.text: The server's ffmpeg has no H.264 encoder: video a device can't play by itself won't open.

playback.useGpuHint: Turn off if the GPU produces artifacts: the CPU will encode instead.

transcode.title: CPU and HDR
transcode.text: Without a GPU, or with it turned off, the CPU encodes video. The server measured what it can handle on startup: larger video is scaled down.

playback.toneMappingHint: Only needed when HDR video has to be transcoded — for a browser or a screen without HDR. A TV with HDR plays such video by itself.
playback.toneMappingLimit: The frame is scaled down to {height}p: conversion can't keep up with more.
playback.toneMappingNone: The server's ffmpeg lacks the filters: transcoded HDR video will look washed out.

torrent.description: Download speed, queue and seeding, and the torrent engine network.
torrent.savedRestart: Takes effect after the engine restarts

download.title: Download speed
download.text: Limits Download and torrents added in the panel. Watching ignores the limit so video doesn't stutter.

upload.title: Upload speed
upload.text: How much the engine uploads to peers, including while watching. On a slow connection uploads fill it up and video stutters.

queue.title: Download queue
queue.text: How many downloads run at once. The rest wait, but you can already watch them.
queue.hint: 0 — no queue: everything downloads at once.

seedRule.title: Seeding after download
seedRule.text: What happens to files you downloaded with Download. While a download is in progress or being watched, it always seeds: otherwise peers upload slower.
seedRule.label: Rule
seedRule.hint: A single download can have its own rule in its card in Downloads.
seedRule.ratioHint: Uploaded divided by size: 2 means upload twice what you downloaded.
seedRule.timeHint: Counted from when the download finished.

seedCache.title: Seed what you watched
seedCache.text: Watched torrents stay in the cache and seed until the cache evicts them. Turn this off if uploads get in the way.
seedCache.label: Seed watched torrents

conns.title: Connections
conns.text: How many peers at once. Many connections are hard on a weak router or NAS.
conns.hint: 0 total — no overall limit. A torrent being watched always gets the full per-torrent limit.

port.title: Incoming connections
port.text: The port peers connect to on their own. If it's open on the router, you get more peers.
port.label: Port
port.upnp: Open the port on the router with UPnP
port.upnpHint: The router opens the port itself. Off by default: not every router does this safely.
port.env: Port from ENGINE_PEER_PORT — docker-compose.yml publishes it.
port.envMismatch: docker-compose.yml publishes port {port}: change it there too, or no incoming connections will reach the engine.
port.docker: In Docker, publish the port in docker-compose.yml.

discovery.title: Peer discovery
discovery.text: Where the engine looks for peers besides trackers. Private trackers require DHT and PEX to be off.
discovery.dhtHint: A shared peer network without trackers
discovery.pexHint: Peers share the addresses of other peers
discovery.warning: Without DHT, watching takes longer to find peers, and magnet links without trackers won't open.

encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.preferText: Encrypt when the peer supports it. The most peers.
encryption.requireText: Encrypted connections only. Fewer peers, playback starts slower.

restart.title: Changes are waiting for an engine restart
restart.text: The engine reads the port, UPnP, peer discovery and encryption when it starts.

blocked.not_running: The engine isn't running right now — changes apply when it starts.
blocked.moving: Downloads are being moved. You can restart once the move finishes.

restartDialog.title: Restart the torrent engine?
restartDialog.text: Playback on every device pauses for a few seconds and resumes on its own. Downloads continue after the restart.
restartDialog.watching: {n} torrent is being watched now. | {n} torrents are being watched now.
restartDialog.toastText: The new settings apply once it starts
restartDialog.errorText: It isn't running or is moving downloads. Try again later.

follow.description: How Torsher looks for new episodes of followed titles and which rules new follows get.

rss.title: Read new releases feed
rss.description: How often to read the feed of new releases from each indexer. A single request per indexer covers all follows.
rss.hint: From 10 to 120 minutes, 0 turns the feed off.
rss.off: The feed is off: episodes are found by targeted searches only.

budget.title: Targeted searches per hour
budget.description: Searches by title aliases when an episode aired or a follow was just turned on. Fewer searches are gentler on indexers.
budget.hint: “Search now” doesn't count toward the limit.

defaults.title: Rules for new follows
defaults.description: What a follow gets when it's turned on from the TV. Each follow's rules can be changed later.

auto.title: For foreign titles
auto.text: Required when the original isn't Russian

sources.title: Sources
sources.loadErrorText: The server didn't respond. If the panel has been open for a while, reload the page.

empty.title: Connect your first source
empty.text: The server searches for releases in Torznab indexers. Until there are some, the showcase finds movies and series but has nothing to play them from.
